TEXT:
[FI] At the place where Kirino brought me to... that 
person was already waiting for us.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] I got a call from Kirino-chan... telling me to come 
here.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] Hmm? Do you have a complaint about that? Calling 
her "Mana-chan" like I used to would sound childish.
[FI] That wasn't what I was surprised about...

[FI] Kirino always acts strangely disgusted towards 
Manami whenever she acts over-familiar towards 
her.

[FI] Back then, when I brought Manami over to our 
place...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] It's been a while. Do you remember me?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] I don't remember you at all. Who might you be?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Kirino, why are you acting like this today... Wait, did 
you remember about the past?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] "Mana-chan", huh... Even I forgot that you called her 
that.

[FI] And this location... she called it "where we used to 
play together as kids".
[FI] Isn't that being vague on purpose?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Thank you for remembering me, Kirino-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] Even though you came all the way to our house to 
hang out, I only said unpleasant things to you.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] It's fine. I understand Kirino-chan's feelings 
somewhat.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Thank you for forgiving me, Manami-san.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] Kirino-chan is an important childhood friend... like a 
little sister to me, after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] If possible... I thought it would be nice if we could 
get along like we did in the past~

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Even now... I wonder if that's okay?
[FI] Now then, how will Kirino react to this...

[FI] Depending on the situation, I might need to step in 
and mediate.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] We might... be able to get along.
[FI] Then, Kirino looked up at me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] I was able... to reconcile with even Kyousuke, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Anything else is easier than that.
[FI] That's right. The two of us really... didn't get along.
[FI] Surely, even Manami and Kirino can...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Then.. although it's weird to say "let's make up"...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] Shall we... get along with each other again, 
Kirino-chan?
[FI] Manami timidly held out her right hand.
[FI] Then Kirino, as if she had planned for that...

[FI] Acting as if she couldn't resist laughing, yet 
sporadically bursting into laughter.
[FI] And after being so ecstatic , Kirino began to speak.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] The truth is, Kyousuke and I~, aren't related by 
blood~♪

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] It's really true♪ If you think I'm lying, ask 
Kyousuke about it.

[FI] From the beginning, the reason Kirino had called 
out Manami was to explain the circumstances 
surrounding that to her.
[FI] ...This girl really does things her own way.

[FI] Even though it's something that has greatly 
influenced my life.

[FI] Back when Rock (Manami's younger brother) got 
100% on a test by a fluke, her reaction was the 
exact same.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] So! And then! There's still more!! This next part is 
the most important!

[FI] Kirino says that to Manami... as if she had returned 
to being an innocent child.
[FI] Kirino suddenly locked arms with me tightly.

[FI] Is there a point in uselessly stirring up the sense of 
surprise like this?
[FI] Manami was still in a daze.

[FI] On the other hand, Kirino looked at her shocked 
face, and...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] It's Kiririn's overwhelming victory! Kuhihihihi, I've 
al~ways wanted to see that expression!!

[FI] Kirino thrusted her finger towards Manami's face 
and started ridiculing her with all her strength.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] Hey, how do you feel right now? Hey, hey, 
Manami-san, how does it feel now that Kyousuke 
has been taken by me?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] Alright then, now that you've savored that feeling! 
Let's shake hands and make up!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Give it a rest, you fool.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Geez... Doing that kind of bullying in bad taste right 
in front of me is just like you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Of course I'm going to hit anyone that makes fun 
of Manami, even my own girlfriend.

[FI] Kirino tried to say something with a rebellious look 
in her eye, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hurry up and apologize, come on.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] B-But... my grudge from all those years ago...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I see. Then... I've had enough. You...

[FI] Kirino lowered her head, took a quick glance at 
Manami's face.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] I see... So Kirino-chan wanted to say that to me for 
all this time.

[FI] She doesn't look like she's reflecting on her actions 
at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Ahaha, I see. You got back at me real good.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] It's something between the two of us.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] Yes, something between us. It has nothing to do 
with you.
[FI] Basically telling me to step aside for this.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] I don't think what I said back then was wrong... That 
hasn't changed, even now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] Oh really? But, since it's like this now, you can't 
object, right?
[FI] I didn't understand the conversation at all.
[FI] I know it's about something important.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] After all, siblings dating each other... I don't think 
that's normal.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Look! I told you we aren't related by blood!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] Even if you're aren't related by blood, I think 
siblings should just be siblings.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Are you... opposed to Kirino and I dating?
[FI] Since I've known her for a long time, I understand.
[FI] Manami is opposed to us going out. For real.

[FI] And, changing her opinion when she becomes like 
this is almost next to impossible.

[FI] I've always thought that no matter who became 
my enemy, this person at least... would always side 
with me.

[FI] To think... that I would make Manami my enemy 
today.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] I want to support Kyou-chan if he has a lover, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] Only if it's Kirino-chan, then it becomes a different 
situation.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] I mean, you two are siblings, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] In that case... if I think that siblings dating each 
other is strange, that means it's the "normal" way 
of thinking, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] "But, that has nothing to do with this~", are you 
going to yell that now? Like you did in the past.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Like when you stood up to your father.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] Do you think you can also coax me just with your 
enthusiasm and passion?

[FI] Up until now, I resolved many troubles... by leaving it 
to just that.

[FI] I settled the problems of my little sister and the 
others with a suicide charge as I resolved myself 
to death.

[FI] But... Manami is the only person that tactic won't 
work on.

[FI] No matter what vivid words I yell at her, I cannot 
convince Manami here.
[FI] I can't persuade her with a sob story either.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Even if it's impossible, I have to do it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] More important than my parents or anyone else, if 
you don't approve of it... then it's no good to me.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Yeah. I thought you would say that, knowing you.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] If I don't approve it, you can no longer date 
Kirino-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Hmm? But, that's how it is, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] "You should ignore what the plain girl says and just 
enjoy yourself with me."

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] ...That kind of thing won't get through to this guy, 
after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] Unless we get your blessing the right way, I can't 
feel satisfied.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Oh yeah? Whatever you say then.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] It's not like it'll change what we have to do, anyway.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] This time, right now... I'm not leaving it all up to you 
alone.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] I'll charge into this together with you, break 
through this with you.
